verdict.rationale: Chroma documents its own deployment options that control where data lives: run it locally, self-host, or use a BYOC single-tenant deployment in your own VPC. Its marketing also mentions multi-cloud/multi-region replication, but nothing documents choosing a region or data-residency guarantee within managed Chroma Cloud. Missing for 10: documented region selection for Chroma Cloud, explicit data-residency commitments or compliance docs, details of BYOC region/cloud choice, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.
We offer a BYOC (bring your own cloud) option for single-tenant deployments.
BYOC in your VPC, multi-cloud/multi-region replication, point-in-time-recovery ensure a resilient and scalable search system
